senses.definition: Tetrasomy X, a rare chromosomal disorder affecting females, caused by the presence of four X chromosomes instead of two present in the usual human karyotype.
An extremely rare and often fatal aneuploidic sex-chromosomal abnormality with symptoms somewhat similar to Klinefelter syndrome.
A genetic condition characterized by a sex chromosome aneuploidy, with the presence of two extra X chromosomes.
Having an aneuploidy in the configuration of chromosomes by having an extra Y chromosome.
A sex chromosome anomaly in which a male has an extra X chromosome and an extra Y chromosome.
